name: batch-evidence-read
goal: Read immutable evidence blobs in batches while preserving every hash, missing-file and lineage check.

evidence: Actual pinned framework evidence started 8,093 blob-reader processes and took 88,608 ms. Preserve the complete validated answer, binary bytes, file ordering and failure behavior while batching reads.

An isolated Git archive running the previous serial read fails the unchanged one-batch binary regression: expected 1 cat-file process, received 4. The generated helper also failed all four bounded-read tests before implementation.

Batched immutable evidence blobs and metadata reads; retained per-file hashes, LFS validation, record seals and pinned ancestry. Copy each returned buffer. Independent integrity review found no blockers.

17 focused tests pass, including corrupted/inherited records, binary framing, metadata ordering, concurrency bounds and registry integration. The headless scenario wrapper passes. Same-pins actual answers are deeply identical; 94 blob-reader calls versus 8,093.
